description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalama District - Cad. Map No. 410004 (24/1140)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for a specific land parcel (No. 1:490) in Lunuwila. It includes detailed land particulars such as parcel number, extent, owner details, title class, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
